context.classification: separate in-memory codec diagnostic, not a Rust or CDN benchmark
context.order: rotating corpus and codec order, sequential; no compression during decode measurements
context.input: Exactly the optimized portable payloads, u32 program length + programs + FPRT002 groups. SHA-256 identity checked against the Rust matrix. Every decode compares all output bytes outside timing.
limits: Local Node builtin native codecs only; does not establish browser or Rust decoding speed.
Time includes output allocation, excludes I/O, bridge, Rust load, and teardown; garbage collection and host activity can affect samples.
Only the ten optimized portable packages were measured; Rust source and payload format are unchanged.
